name: CNPC Capital Company Limited
summary: CNPC Capital Company Limited provides financial services in China and internationally. It provides savings deposits, personal loans, bank cards, investment and wealth management, and credit cards; deposit settlement, traditional financing, investment banking, supply chain financing, and corporate credit; and international settlement, international trade finance, and foreign exchange business. The company also offers payment and collection, internal transfer settlement, bill acceptance and discounting; financial leasing, operating leasing and sale-leaseback; and asset servicing trust, asset management trust, and charitable trust.
